[1/2] Progression cycle: load .bak when the main profile is missing, with restart tests, a recovery pair and backup-restart drill

impact_assessment.why: After a corrupt main is quarantined and .bak loads in memory, quitting without a save leaves no main; the next launch treats the missing file as a fresh profile and ignores the backup, losing progress.
impact_assessment.benefits: A missing main with a valid backup now restores the profile and reports PROFILE RECOVERED instead of defaulting.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: profile load path only; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: schema, quarantine and atomic writes unchanged.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first restart tests, a backup-restart capture pair, a drill and the full gates.

[1/2] Combat-feel cycle: add a 0.35 s brute windup with a swell and cue, with first-frame delay tests, a windup pair and drills

impact_assessment.why: The brute slam deals 20 damage on the first in-range frame with no prior event; unlike the warden it cannot be read or dodged.
impact_assessment.benefits: A short windup, visible swell and BRUTE WINDUP cue make the slam readable while preserving damage, range, LOS and cooldown.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: brute attack timing/visual/audio; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: deterministic windup field, fairness needs rechecking.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first delay tests, a windup pair, short/long brute drills and the full fairness suite.

[1/2] Enemies cycle: deterministic enemy separation so melee crowds keep their DATA radii, with a spacing test, capture pair and spacing drill

impact_assessment.why: Four mites converge onto the exact same coordinate (min pair gap 0.000) because movement has no enemy separation; the crowd reads as one blob and every bite comes from one point.
impact_assessment.benefits: A deterministic soft-spacing pass keeps alive enemies at least their combined radii apart, so silhouettes, hit targets and damage sources stay distinct.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: enemy movement/determinism; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: new DATA clearance, no RNG, fairness may shift.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first spacing test, a staged capture pair, a spacing drill with min-gap telemetry, and the campaign fairness suite.

[1/2] Keystone testbed cycle: consume the new AnimationStateMachine + StateMachineLibrary + apply_pose in the warden core, with library tests, a charge pair and a same-hash slam run

impact_assessment.why: The shooter is the Keystone testbed, but the new runtime state machine, file-backed .kstate library and apply_pose had no real consumer; the boss core still used a hardcoded 1.18 swell.
impact_assessment.benefits: The warden core now breathes in calm and pulses to 1.32 in charge from a committed .kstate asset, proving the new Keystone APIs in shipped gameplay.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: boss-core presentation only; dependency: .kstate shipped asset; concurrency: none; state: no sim/hash change, missing asset falls back to the old pulse.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Five focused tests, a charge-peak capture pair, a same-hash slam run and the full gates.
